description: Cross-company and cross-group market intelligence, tender monitoring signals, and strategic routing rules for the full Geologix Vanguard portfolio.
purpose: AI agents should read this folder when performing cross-portfolio analysis, tender opportunity mapping, or strategic signal routing across multiple companies simultaneously.
ai_read_instructions: Start with this index.json, then read the JSON and document files listed below for cross-portfolio intelligence. Do NOT move files from this folder into individual company folders.

files.filename: Comprehensive Tender Monitoring System for South African Industrial Sectors.docx
